test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven sisters, Anita, Babita, Sunita, Dixita, Rita, Lalita and Geeta are standing in a row facing north. Lalita is standing to the immediate right of Rita who stands fourth to the right of Geeta. Only Sunita stands exactly between Babita and Dixita. Dixita stands at the middle position.Who stands at the rightmost position?
solution:
Given: Seven sisters, Anita, Babita, Sunita, Dixita, Rita, Lalita and Geeta are standing in a row facing north.

1) Lalita is standing to the immediate right of Rita who stands fourth to the right of Geeta.

**Case 1:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fd0fb700c2dae0c51d265b24ca9985ba6ceb8a4ba5da54be4b44c994bd0d790.png] 

**Case 2:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b02b3f4a74da611818ff4c0f55b75d16217bc9b31c04939a10e8c57a3958e2a2.png] 

2) Dixita stands at the middle position.

Case 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31614a1cba8d2165ccc1aff36709407dc4c40eb6ce692c8581246f98a729a90c.png] 

Case 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1842edfaf534557b5a209da85fefe9dc7c296db17604413133f946f4d42d519a.png] 

3) Only Sunita stands exactly between Babita and Dixita.

(Here case 2 is eliminated because this condition is not applied here)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a2bf9f92ed7ab1c06b207323c66df4bd12dd7dc479d4719dc19a1f775e30217.png] 

Clearly, **Anita **sits at the rightmost position.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Anita".**
